# AABB - Association for the Advancement of Blood & Biotherapies

> AABB is the professional organization advancing blood transfusion, cellular therapies, and biotherapies through standards, education, research funding, and annual conferences.

AABB serves healthcare professionals, researchers, and the public with resources on blood donation, transfusion medicine, stem cell therapies, and biotherapies. The organization hosts an annual meeting, administers research grants, and maintains accreditation standards for blood banking and DNA testing facilities.

## Key Topics

- Transfusion medicine
- Blood biotherapies
- Cellular therapies
- Blood donation
- AABB Annual Meeting
- AABB Foundation
- Research grants
- Blood banking standards
- Cord blood banking
- DNA testing accreditation
- Donor eligibility
- Continuing medical education
- CAR T-cell research
- Hemophilia
- Sickle cell disease

## Core Resources

- [Home - Association for the Advancement of Blood & Biotherapies](https://www.aabb.org/home): AABB homepage featuring blood biotherapies, standards, and annual meeting
- [For Donors & Patients - Association for the Advancement of Blood & Biotherapies](https://www.aabb.org/for-donors-patients): Main resource hub for blood donors and patients on transfusion and therapies
- [Annual Meeting - Association for the Advancement of Blood & Biotherapies](https://www.aabb.org/annual-meeting): AABB Annual Meeting 2026 in Atlanta with registration and abstracts
- [AABB Foundation - Association for the Advancement of Blood & Biotherapies](https://www.aabb.org/foundation): AABB Foundation research grants and funding programs for blood science

## Blood Donation & Patient Education

- [Where to Donate Blood](https://www.aabb.org/for-donors-patients/give-blood): Blood donation site locator and information on accredited facilities
- [About Blood Donation](https://www.aabb.org/for-donors-patients/about-blood-donation): Comprehensive guide covering donation process, requirements, and safety
- [Why Donate Blood](https://www.aabb.org/for-donors-patients/why-donate-blood): Educational guide on blood donation importance and public health impact
- [FAQs About Blood and Blood Donation](https://www.aabb.org/for-donors-patients/faqs-about-blood-and-blood-donation): FAQ addressing blood donation, safety, eligibility, and COVID-19 guidelines
- [Cord Blood And Other Cellular Therapies](https://www.aabb.org/for-donors-patients/cord-blood-other-cell-therapies): Patient education on cord blood banking, stem cells, and cellular therapies

## Research Funding & Grants

- [Introducing the AABB Foundation](https://www.aabb.org/foundation/introducing-the-aabb-foundation): Foundation history, mission, and overview of research funding initiatives
- [Early-Career Scientific Research Grants Program](https://www.aabb.org/foundation/early-career-scientific-research-grants-program): Grant program details for early-career transfusion medicine researchers
- [Process Development Grant](https://www.aabb.org/foundation/process-development-grant): Grant program for blood therapy process development and CAR T-cell research
- [Scientific Research Grant Award Recipients](https://www.aabb.org/foundation/annual-grant-recipients): List of 2025 grant recipients in transfusion medicine and stem cell research

## Annual Meeting & Professional Development

- [About the Meeting](https://www.aabb.org/annual-meeting/go): Overview of AABB Annual Meeting in Nashville with health and safety info
- [Continuing Medical Education Information and Policies](https://www.aabb.org/annual-meeting/learn): CME credit information and policies for AABB Annual Meeting attendees
- [2026 Call for Education Session Proposals](https://www.aabb.org/annual-meeting/present): Guidelines for submitting education session proposals for 2026 meeting
- [2026 AABB Annual Meeting](https://www.aabb.org/annual-meeting/exhibit): Exhibitor opportunities and sponsorship information for Atlanta 2026 meeting

## Accredited Facilities & Services

- [AABB-Accredited Relationship (DNA) Testing Facilities](https://www.aabb.org/for-donors-patients/find-a-dna-lab): Directory of AABB-accredited DNA testing facilities for relationship testing
